objective: Discover and falsify 10 lawful zero-cost onchain quote/exit primitives using 8 bounded independent hypotheses, then connect only source-admitted results to original Alpha Lab Pro site and S1/Claude review.
tool_dispatch_policy: Existing GitHub read-only and pre-existing CI only after exact original authorization and free capacity verification

acceptance: Each lane must return independently source-pinned finding with artifact SHA and source first-known; missing means UNKNOWN. All lanes planned, not eight agents or jobs.

lanes.name: Provider rights and source capability truth
lanes.question: Can legal zero-cost sources reproduce every required size/fee/trace primitive without proprietary API data?
lanes.baseline: Pons/Uniswap/0x official docs and licenses; public chain read contracts
lanes.hypothesis: A nonproprietary, admissible source exists for each priority P0 primitive.
lanes.falsifier: Provider access, archive state or licensing is unavailable or inconsistent.
lanes.stop_rule: No qualified free source, rights, budget, current original owner, or as-of data => BLOCKED_WITH_EXPLICIT_TRIGGER; no surrogate live claims.

lanes.name: Pons V2 exact-size quote and phase fault cases
lanes.question: Does the exact integer fee/phase quote replay genuine same-block CurveBuy/CurveSell outputs better than spot proxy?
lanes.baseline: Public Pons ABI/math, exact block chain RPC and prior CurveSell event
lanes.hypothesis: Size-aware Pons quote reproduces observed output within source rounding and returns UNKNOWN correctly on phase gap.
lanes.falsifier: Fails on source-bound actual event or requires nonfree historical state.
lanes.stop_rule: No qualified free source, rights, budget, current original owner, or as-of data => BLOCKED_WITH_EXPLICIT_TRIGGER; no surrogate live claims.
